items.description: Accepted contract-enforcement and export corrections lack direct regression coverage.
items.analysis: The suite passes, but it does not assert URI-format enforcement, fixed runtime contract ownership, dual diagnostics, destination/finding constraints, exported registry content, or supported cleanup behaviour.
items.recommendation: Add focused behavioural cases for the accepted corrections.

items.description: Exported schemas cannot resolve absolute internal references offline by themselves.
items.analysis: An external offline consumer needs a URI-to-exported-file mapping or documented registry configuration.
items.recommendation: Include a mapping resource or document exported-schema loader configuration.

items.analysis: This overlaps the accepted tracker destination finding and adds the documented spike findings-status constraint.
items.recommendation: Tighten those constraints with invalid-instance coverage.

items.description: Forced export over a regular file leaves a backup and can traceback.
items.analysis: Backup cleanup assumes a directory although an existing export destination can be a file.
items.recommendation: Handle file and directory backups safely.

items.description: Export cleanup failures can escape as a traceback.
items.analysis: Cleanup occurs outside the current SchemaRegistryError conversion.
items.recommendation: Convert cleanup failures to concise export errors.

items.description: Only the first invalid runtime contract is reported.
items.analysis: The two runtime records can be checked independently before lifecycle-specific validation is skipped.

items.description: Existing unversioned installations fail strict validation.
items.analysis: The project has no released predecessor or update command; this change deliberately establishes the first supported baseline and rejects unversioned records.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: no existing user population or prior released contract exists. Future update work may define migration if required.

items.description: validate_instance does not honour non-dict Mapping inputs.
items.analysis: The API accepts Mapping but the JSON Schema object validator recognises dict values.
items.recommendation: Normalise mappings to dict before validation.

items.analysis: A non-null destination is documented as having the same identifying fields as a source link.
items.recommendation: Require system, kind, id, and url for destinations.

items.description: Runtime validation accepts the wrong supported contract for a file.
items.analysis: Runtime files have fixed public contract ownership and must not validate through another supported resource.
items.recommendation: Require the expected public contract URI for each runtime file.

items.description: URI format constraints are not enforced.
items.analysis: The validator is constructed without a format checker, leaving schema URI constraints advisory.

items.description: Validation diagnostics may include invalid record values.
items.analysis: Schema validation messages can interpolate offending instance values into terminal or CI output.
items.recommendation: Report only the failing path and validation rule.

items.description: Interrupted forced export can temporarily leave the destination absent.
items.analysis: The concern assumes process interruption during replacement of a user-managed local destination.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: interruption recovery is outside the local user-managed scope.

items.description: Non-forced concurrent exports can overwrite each other.
items.analysis: The concern assumes concurrent callers against the same user-selected destination.
items.recommendation: Add no-clobber atomic publishing or locking.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: concurrent export coordination is outside the local user-managed model.

items.description: Forced export replaces a symlink target.
items.analysis: The concern assumes that a user-selected export destination must be protected from its own symlink semantics.
items.recommendation: Reject or specially replace final symlink destinations.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: trusted local users choose their export destination and its symlink semantics.

items.description: The runtime-contract test named for unversioned records supplies an unknown schema URI rather than an absent `$schema` field.
items.analysis: The helper adds a valid `$schema` when it is absent, so the test exercises unsupported-contract handling only. Requirement 2 requires actionable errors for both missing and unsupported versions at the runtime boundary.
items.recommendation: Add a direct missing-marker runtime case or adjust the helper so the test proves the missing-marker diagnostic.
items.dispatch_result: Task 4 reopened for the active change; missing-marker runtime coverage remains to be implemented.

items.description: Schema export collision and replacement are tested, but staging or replacement failure does not prove that the original destination is retained.
items.analysis: Failure-safe replacement is an explicit design and task requirement. The implementation has a recovery path, but it lacks behavioural evidence for that path.
items.recommendation: Add a focused failure-injection test that confirms the prior destination remains intact after an export replacement failure.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: export failure injection is disproportionate for the expected user-managed destination model.

items.description: Distributed context guidance examples omit the required `$schema` contract marker.
items.analysis: The context skill now instructs writers to add the marker, but the canonical context guidance still presents unversioned current-issue and context JSON shapes. This conflicts with the baseline-contract documentation requirement.
items.recommendation: Add the context and current-issue baseline schema URIs to those examples, then synchronise active steering.
items.dispatch_result: Task 8 reopened for the active change; canonical context guidance will be updated and synchronised.
